COST: 170

All 11 elderly people are rescued to Shivapuri shelter, the only designated evacuation point, with no deferrals. The Kalika run takes 14 minutes, and the Trishuli farm residents need two 78-minute round trips because the car holds four. Deferring any of them would cost 50 each, which is more than the extra driving, so rescuing everyone is cheaper.
